situations.title: CAM-ICU 선별 시행
situations.tagline: Let's run the CAM-ICU on him this shift — can you walk through it with me?
situations.brief: CAM-ICU 선별을 시행해 섬망 유무를 정확히 판정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's start CAM-ICU with his baseline mental status.
We check inattention and disorganized thinking next.
If two features are positive, he screens delirious.

situations.title: 지남력·환경 조정
situations.tagline: 환자가 지금이 밤인지 낮인지 모르겠다며 두리번거린다.
situations.brief: 시계와 달력, 조명을 활용해 환자의 지남력과 환경을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: It's Tuesday morning, and you're in the hospital ICU.
I put a clock and calendar where you can see them.
I'll open the blinds so you know it's daytime.

situations.title: 수면 위생 중재
situations.tagline: He barely slept last night — let's cluster care so he can rest tonight.
situations.brief: 야간 소음과 조도를 조절해 수면 위생을 개선하는 중재를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's dim the lights and lower the alarms overnight.
We'll cluster his care so we don't wake him repeatedly.
Good sleep lowers his delirium risk.

situations.title: 조기 이동·활동 격려
situations.tagline: Would you help me get him sitting at the edge of the bed this morning?
situations.brief: 조기 이동과 활동을 격려해 비약물적으로 섬망을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get him up to the edge of the bed today.
Early mobility helps prevent and shorten delirium.
I'll support his lines while you steady him.

situations.title: 가족 참여·안심
situations.tagline: 딸이 아버지 곁에서 어떻게 도우면 좋을지 조심스레 묻는다.
situations.brief: 익숙한 가족의 존재를 활용해 환자를 안심시키고 참여를 유도하세요.
keyPhrases: Your familiar voice really helps keep him oriented.
You can hold his hand and remind him where he is.
Bring in a family photo or his glasses if you can.

situations.title: 유발요인 스크리닝
situations.tagline: Before we blame delirium, let's rule out pain, a full bladder, or infection.
situations.brief: 통증과 요저류 등 섬망 유발요인을 체계적으로 스크리닝하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's screen for pain, retention, and hypoxia first.
Check his bladder scan and last bowel movement.
Treating the trigger often clears the confusion.

situations.title: 저활동형 섬망 인지
situations.tagline: He's so quiet and withdrawn — I think we might be missing hypoactive delirium.
situations.brief: 놓치기 쉬운 저활동형 섬망을 인지하고 조용한 환자를 세심히 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Quiet doesn't mean fine — this could be hypoactive delirium.
Let's run CAM-ICU even though he's calm.
Withdrawn and inattentive patients are easy to miss.

situations.title: 과활동형 초조 비약물 관리
situations.tagline: 환자가 손짓을 크게 하며 집에 가야 한다고 반복해서 소리를 높인다.
situations.brief: 과활동형 초조를 de-escalation 등 비약물적으로 먼저 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear you — you're safe and I'm here to help.
Let's take a slow breath together and lower our voices.
You're in the hospital, and I'll stay right beside you.

situations.title: 유발약물 검토·조정
situations.tagline: He's on a benzo and an anticholinergic — could those be driving the delirium?
situations.brief: 벤조디아제핀과 항콜린성 등 유발약물을 검토하고 조정을 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: Benzodiazepines and anticholinergics can worsen delirium.
Let's review his med list for deliriogenic drugs.
We can propose safer alternatives to the team.

situations.title: 수면-각성 주기 회복 전략
situations.tagline: Let's put the ABCDEF bundle to work and rebuild his day-night rhythm.
situations.brief: 번들을 적용해 환자의 수면-각성 주기를 회복하는 전략을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Daytime light and activity, nighttime quiet and dark.
The ABCDEF bundle ties sedation, mobility, and sleep together.
Let's protect a block of uninterrupted sleep tonight.

situations.title: 섬망 중 진정 최소화
situations.tagline: He's delirious and still deeply sedated — we're stuck in a vicious cycle.
situations.brief: 진정과 섬망의 악순환을 차단하기 위해 섬망 중 진정을 최소화하세요.
keyPhrases: Deeper sedation is feeding his delirium, not fixing it.
Let's lighten sedation and lean on non-drug measures.
Breaking the cycle means less sedative, more orientation.

situations.title: 감각 보조 제공
situations.tagline: 환자가 안경과 보청기가 없어서 무슨 말인지 잘 모르겠다고 답답해한다.
situations.brief: 안경과 보청기 등 감각 보조를 제공해 지남력과 소통을 돕세요.
keyPhrases: Let me get your glasses and hearing aids for you.
Can you hear me better now that these are in?
Seeing and hearing clearly helps you stay oriented.

situations.title: 억제대 최소화 대안
situations.tagline: Instead of restraints, can we try a sitter and closer observation first?
situations.brief: 최소 억제 원칙에 따라 억제대 대신 대안 중재를 우선 적용하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's try a sitter and reorientation before restraints.
Restraints can worsen agitation and cause injury.
We use the least restrictive option that keeps him safe.

situations.title: 알코올 금단 섬망 감별
situations.tagline: His tremor and sweating started on day three — is this CIWA territory, not just delirium?
situations.brief: CIWA와 구분해 알코올 금단 섬망을 감별하고 대응 방향을 정하세요.
keyPhrases: Tremor, sweating, and tachycardia point to withdrawal.
Let's use CIWA to guide benzodiazepine dosing here.
Withdrawal delirium is treated differently from ICU delirium.

situations.title: 가족에게 섬망 설명·교육
situations.tagline: 아들이 아버지가 갑자기 이상한 말을 한다며 치매가 온 거냐고 놀라 묻는다.
situations.brief: 가족의 오해를 해소하며 섬망의 원인과 경과를 이해하기 쉽게 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: This confusion is delirium, and it's usually temporary.
It's caused by his illness, not permanent dementia.
Your presence and familiar things really help him recover.

situations.title: 극심 초조 자타해 위험 위기
situations.tagline: 환자가 침대에서 뛰쳐나가려 하며 주먹을 휘둘러 직원을 위협한다.
situations.brief: 극심한 초조로 자타해 위험이 있을 때 약물과 안전 에스컬레이션으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He's a danger to himself — call for help and clear the area.
Let's get emergency medication orders and extra staff now.
Keep everyone safe while we de-escalate and secure him.

situations.title: 섬망 중 라인·튜브 자가제거 급변
situations.tagline: 환자가 순식간에 중심정맥관과 위관을 뽑아버려 피가 배어난다.
situations.brief: 섬망 중 라인과 튜브 자가제거가 발생하면 즉각 안전을 확보하고 재확보하세요.
keyPhrases: He pulled his central line — hold pressure right now.
Let's assess for bleeding and check his airway.
Secure his hands and we'll replace access urgently.

situations.title: 할로페리돌 사용·QT 감시
situations.tagline: If we use haloperidol for his agitation, we have to watch his QT closely.
situations.brief: 할로페리돌의 위험과 이익을 균형 있게 판단하고 QT를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get a baseline QT before we give haloperidol.
Check his potassium and magnesium to reduce QT risk.
We weigh the agitation risk against QT prolongation.

situations.title: 금단 발작·진전섬망 위기
situations.tagline: 환자가 전신 발작을 일으키며 극도로 초조하고 환시를 호소하는 진전섬망 상태다.
situations.brief: 금단 발작과 진전섬망 위기에 벤조디아제핀 중심으로 중환자 대응을 하세요.
keyPhrases: He's seizing — protect his airway and give the benzo now.
This looks like delirium tremens, escalate the dose.
Let's check his glucose and monitor continuously.

situations.title: 섬망 지속·예후 소통
situations.tagline: 아내가 남편의 혼란이 몇 주째인데 원래대로 돌아올 수 있냐고 지친 목소리로 묻는다.
situations.brief: 섬망이 지속되는 환자의 예후를 가족과 정직하고 지지적으로 상담하세요.
keyPhrases: His delirium is lasting longer than we'd hoped.
Recovery can be gradual, and some confusion may persist.
We'll keep supporting his brain and keep you updated.

situations.title: 억제대 관련 손상·질식 위험 위기
situations.tagline: 억제대에 몸이 뒤엉킨 환자가 목이 조이는 자세로 발버둥치며 얼굴이 붉어진다.
situations.brief: 억제대 관련 손상과 질식 위험 위기에 즉시 대응해 안전사고를 막으세요.
keyPhrases: He's tangled and choking — release the restraints now.
Check his airway and breathing immediately.
Let's reposition him safely and reassess the restraint plan.
